unbound state is managed internally.\n",["strong",{},"Events"]," ",["code",{},"data:change"]," ",["code",{},"data:filterChange"]," ",["code",{},"data:sortChange"]," ",["code",{},"data:pageChange"]," ",["code",{},"status:change"]," ",["code",{},"error"]," ",["code",{},"selection:change"]," ",["code",{},"row:click"]," ",["code",{},"row:action"]," ",["code",{},"export"]," ",["code",{},"refresh"]," ",["code",{},"view:change"]," (+ the ",["code",{},"update:*"]," of the models).\n",["strong",{},"Slots"]," ",["code",{},"header"]," ",["code",{},"toolbar"]," ",["code",{},"toolbar-start"]," ",["code",{},"toolbar-end"]," ",["code",{},"filters"]," ",["code",{},"bulk-actions"]," ",["code",{},"loading"]," ",["code",{},"error"]," ",["code",{},"empty"]," ",["code",{},"chart"]," ",["code",{},"summary"]," ",["code",{},"footer"]," ",["code",{},"actions"]," · per column: ",["code",{},"cell-<key>"],", ",["code",{},"header-<key>"],".\n",["strong",{},"Expose"]," ",["code",{},"refresh()"]," ",["code",{},"resetSearch()"]," ",["code",{},"resetFilters()"]," ",["code",{},"resetSort()"]," ",["code",{},"resetAll()"]," ",["code",{},"exportAs(format, scope?)"]," ",["code",{},"setPage()"]," ",["code",{},"setPageSize()"]," ",["code",{},"clearSelection()"]," ",["code",{},"getState()"]," + ",["code",{},"rows"]," ",["code",{},"status"]," ",["code",{},"error"],".\n",["strong",{},"Options"]," ",["code",{},"searchable searchPlaceholder searchDebounce minSearchLength searchFields filterable paginated pageSizeOptions defaultPageSize sortable multiSort selectable rowKey columnToggle refreshable rowActions retry retryDelay dense striped stickyHeader summary export chart"]," — see ",["code",{},"splendor.types.ts"],".\n",["strong",{},"Labels"]," pass ",["code",{},":labels"]," for i18n (English defaults), ",["code",{},":locale"]," for number / date / sort formatting."],["p",{},"Behaviour guarantees: search / filter / sort / page-size changes reset to page 1 and produce ",["strong",{},"one"]," request; each new request aborts the previous one and late responses are ignored; an out-of-range page jumps to the last real page; retries (",["code",{},"options.retry"],", exponential ",["code",{},"retryDelay"],") apply to network errors, 5xx, 408 and 429 only; in API mode a failure keeps the previous rows visible with a banner; all timers and in-flight requests are cleaned up on unmount."],["h2",{"id":"validation-what-was-and-was-not-run"},"Validation (what was and was not run)"],["p",{},"Run in a scratch project (Vue 3.5, TypeScript 5.8, vitest 5, happy-dom, ",["code",{},"vue-tsc"],", ",["code",{},"sass-embedded"],"):"],["ul",{},["li",{},["code",{},"vue-tsc --noEmit"]," on the SFCs, composables, utils and both demo pages — clean (and confirmed it fails on a deliberate error)."],["li",{},"50 vitest tests — pure helpers, the engine (stale responses, aborts, retries, coalescing, page clamping, missing totals, 401 / offline / mapping errors), and the mounted component in both modes (debounce, sort cycle, selection, export, error/retry, unmount abort, the ",["code",{},"@data:filterChange"]," listener names)."],["li",{},["code",{},".xlsx"]," output opened with openpyxl (zip CRC, Khmer text, numbers, booleans, escaping)."]],["p",{},"Not run: ESLint (no config was provided), the real Nuxt app, the real Nuxt UI components (stubbed in tests), your real ",["code",{},"useHttp"]," / backend."],["h2",{"id":"known-limitations"},"Known limitations"],["ul",{},["li",{},["strong",{},"Project files I could not inspect:"]," only ",["code",{},"http.ts"]," was available. No ",["code",{},"RInput"]," / ",["code",{},"RSelect"]," / pagination component, ",["code",{},"models/http"],", ",["code",{},"package.json"]," or test setup were visible, so the UI uses Nuxt UI primitives (",["code",{},"UInput"],", ",["code",{},"UButton"],", ",["code",{},"UPagination"],", ",["code",{},"UPopover"],", ",["code",{},"UDropdownMenu"],", ",["code",{},"UBadge"],", ",["code",{},"UIcon"],") and native selects/inputs, and tests use vitest (Nuxt''s default). Swap in your ",["code",{},"R*"]," components where they fit."],["li",{},["strong",{},["code",{},"useHttp"]," assumptions"]," (from ",["code",{},"http.ts"]," and the dashboard''s usage): ",["code",{},"params"]," carries GET query values, ",["code",{},"body"]," the payload for other methods, and ",["code",{},"options.signal"]," cancels. Confirm ",["code",{},"useOptions"]," maps them that way."],["li",{},["strong",{},"Aborted requests"]," come back from ",["code",{},"useHttp"]," with ",["code",{},"error: undefined"],"; the engine detects staleness with its own request id and signal, so this is handled — but ",["code",{},"useHttp"]," itself still sets the upload/toast side effects it always does."],["li",{},["strong",{},"Export:"]," CSV and Excel are built in (no dependency). There is no cell styling in Excel."],["li",{},["strong",{},"Chart view"]," plots the rows currently shown (the current page in API mode)."],["li",{},["strong",{},"i18n:"]," no ",["code",{},"useI18n"]," keys are invented — pass ",["code",{},"labels"],"."],["li",{},["strong",{},"Page-size changes from the parent"]," that are not in ",["code",{},"pageSizeOptions"]," are accepted and added to the dropdown."],["li",{},"Server-reported ",["code",{},"page"]," / ",["code",{},"pageSize"]," in a response are parsed but not used to overwrite the requested
